analogy.rationale: ACE inhibitors act on the renin-angiotensin system, but these cell lines express little ACE/ACE2 and the 978-gene transcriptional readout at 6-24 h is unlikely to capture strong pathway-specific signatures; the closest expected responses are other RAS-targeting or anti-inflammatory/MMP-related classes, though all are expected to be weak.
